name: Airbus-BMW Quantum Computing Challenge
description: The Airbus-BMW Quantum Computing Challenge, titled "The Quantum Mobility Quest", was a year-long international competition launched in December 2023 and hosted by The Quantum Insider to identify quantum computing applications for aviation and automotive mobility problems. Phase one received detailed proposals from over 100 teams across more than 25 countries. Finalists were given Amazon Braket credits and access to QPUs from IonQ, IQM, QuEra, and Rigetti. Five winning teams — from the University of Southern California, University of Hamburg, 4colors Research (UK), Quandela (France), and TU Delft — were announced at Q2B Silicon Valley on 10 December 2024, each awarded EUR 30,000 across five categories: Quantum Simulation, Quantum Solvers, Quantum-powered Logistics, Quantum-Enhanced Autonomy, and the Golden App.
eligibility: Open to global teams and individuals

news.title: Winners announced in the Airbus-BMW Group Quantum Computing Challenge
news.excerpt: The five winning teams of the Airbus and BMW Group Quantum Computing Challenge were announced at the Q2B conference in Silicon Valley, California. Winners include University of Southern California, University of Hamburg, 4colors Research Ltd, Quandela, and TU Delft, with solutions for Smart Coating, Quantum Powered Logistics, Quantum Enhanced Autonomy, Quantum Solvers, and the Golden App categories.
